# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability
Email **dev@daedabyte.com** with "SECURITY" in the subject, or use GitHub's private
vulnerability reporting (Security tab → "Report a vulnerability") on the affected repo.
Please do not open a public issue for security problems.

Expect an initial acknowledgement within a few business days. As a solo-maintained
agency, there is no formal SLA, but security reports are triaged ahead of feature work.

## Supported versions
These are live, continuously deployed sites — only the currently deployed `main`
of each repo is supported. There are no back-ported releases.
